subject: knowledge 写动词的 CAS 用 store marker 版本,不是链版本
summary: 引擎 knowledge-create/promote/retire/rebase/reverify 全部以 store.json 的 version 做 CAS;仪式按链版本供给会 KNOWLEDGE_CAS_MISMATCH。
snippet: knowledge-marker-cas:knowledge 写动词 CAS 用 marker。

subject: hook 注册必须用 ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} 形态,禁止裸相对路径
summary: INC-040 死因:注册用裸相对路径致 hook 从未启动;活性门须执行注册字符串本身,不起进程冒充。
snippet: hook-cwd-trap:注册用 ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR},活性门执行注册字符串。

subject: 远程 argv 经 ssh 重新拼接,必须 shellQuote

snippet: ssh-shellquote:远程参数一律引号包裹。

subject: The short commit-citation form is ambiguous for two record keys in five
summary: Partitions number independently, so INIT-009 names a different record in each. The convention requires the full external key; the short form is four times more common and cannot identify a chain.
snippet: Measured 2026-08-19 over 609 completed cross-project records: 11.2 percent cite the full key, 43.5 percent the short form, 56.5 percent nothing. 242 of 609 short forms collide across partitions.

subject: 上下文将满不是收尾的理由
summary: 压缩自动发生;停下的正当理由只有实质阻塞(owner_intent_required/对外发布/硬阻断),不是资源余量。
snippet: context-limit-is-not-a-reason-to-stop:停只因实质阻塞。

subject: guard-check writes its injected mutations into the live working tree while it runs
summary: Any concurrent gate run or file edit during guard-check reads a deliberately broken tree, and edits made during the run invalidate its verdict.
snippet: Running verify-portal alongside guard-check produced six false red portal cases on 2026-08-19. Treat it as exclusive, wait on the pid, and confirm the mutation is restored before continuing.

subject: 门的判定必须宿主无关
summary: 一个输入若不在所有会运行该门的宿主上在场,就不能进判决;跨仓那半降 observation 或上移到看得见两仓的层
snippet: 判定按宿主而异即选错参照物;拆问题,不列豁免名册

subject: Four wrong readings in two days all came from asking a narrower question than the one being answered
summary: Each measurement used an instrument that could only return the answer already expected. The tell is that the probe's scope is narrower than the claim it is used to support.
snippet: Empty knowledge store read off a search with no matching card; a dropped scope field read off the wrong receipt path; 11.2 percent traceability measured on one of two citation spellings; a load-sensitive test declared a flake from two isolated runs.

subject: 树里对不代表记录对(INC-039)

snippet: committed-claims:声明块须已提交,不只在工作树。

subject: A knowledge read refuses after any chain write unless asked to tolerate a trailing store
summary: The store's marker must equal the chain head, and every chain event breaks that. Pass allow-trailing true on the five metadata-first read verbs; the answer then carries both heads.
snippet: One work-create took all six partitions' knowledge reads dark until a hand-run rebase. Reads accept --allow-trailing true since TCRN-CROSS-INC-226; writes, validate and rebase are not exempt.

subject: 每次链写都拉开知识 store 标记差距,写路径必须自动 rebase
summary: 知识 store 是 disposable 物化索引,每次链写使 eventHighWaterDigest 落后;仪式真写后自动 rebase 保持读面可用。
snippet: marker-rebase-discipline:每写必 rebase。

subject: 凭据不是实现的前置
summary: 凭据是运行期配置;需凭据的步骤单列,其余本地可完成可测,不让凭据阻塞实现。
snippet: credentials-not-implementation-blocker:凭据单列,其余本地可完成。

subject: 报缺陷前先怀疑自己的探针
summary: 平台累计十二次误报的共同根因是探针只看一侧或探针本身有误;报缺陷前先用已知好的输入校准探针。
snippet: probe-before-defect:先校准探针,再报缺陷。

subject: 证据不得携带宿主路径(INC-037/042)
summary: 仓内证据含本机 home 路径会让公开仓付出 93 提交改写代价;证据落盘必须 scrub,门扫 tracked+evidence 树。
snippet: evidence-hygiene:证据 scrub 宿主路径,门扫 tracked+evidence。

subject: 多代理并发时每个都对,文件最后是错的
summary: 并发代理各自局部正确,顺序写文件会互相覆盖;验证须重跑注释里的 MEASURED 连前提。
snippet: agents-right-in-sequence-file-wrong:并发验证须重跑全部前提。

subject: On the knowledge verbs, expected-version is the store's own version rather than the chain's
summary: Every other verb reads that flag as the chain version. The knowledge verbs read it as the knowledge store's version, and nothing in the catalog distinguishes the two meanings.
snippet: Passing chain version 4295 returned KNOWLEDGE_CAS_MISMATCH 4295:160 -- supplied first, expected second. Read the refusal rather than guessing a second time.
